name: Self Esteem 2
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-esteem is rooted in the understanding that we are created in God's image, fearfully and wonderfully made by His hand (Genesis 1:27; Psalms 139:13-14). Our value is not found in outward beauty or human approval, which are fleeting, but in being precious and honored by God Himself (Proverbs 31:30; Isaiah 43:4). This assurance empowers believers to face life with courage and confidence, knowing the Lord is always with them (Joshua 1:9).
